entry_points.text: Open validates and installs; probe constructors decode return and offset; migration moves pinned then flexible members; boot and reboot share mask helpers.
Mappings install on creation, mark on overlapping unmap, propagate on fork and release on teardown; resume completes stepping; syscall path resolves probes; init registers notifier.
Module notifier adds on coming with rollback and removes on going; symbol sequence hides denied values; buffered programs run per entry; process open caches visibility.
Unit, group, sysfs and exception callbacks dispatch; weak breakpoint defaults apply; output reserves forward or backward; self-test exercises placements with exhaustion checks.

exports.text: Tracepoint and breakpoint delivery walk subscribers with per-record reinit; probe constructors check type, privilege and sampling before installing teardown.
Units publish after name and scope checks with type, device and per-processor contexts; removal refuses busy events; kernel counters bypass descriptors; program attach serializes.
Inheritance tears down on failure; boot prepares identifiers and base units; processor hotplug manages masks with migration; control groups allocate and migrate tasks.
Breakpoint slots reserve and release; kernel, user and wide registration install with modify through temporary deactivation; unregister detaches and usage query reports occupancy.
User probes validate and propagate with rollback, toggle by direction; opcode placement handles copy-on-write; arch supplies out-of-line area; fork duplicates state.
Static keys offer count, enable and disable with processor-guarded inner variants, deferred release and text query; symbol iteration visits all names or a resolved range with early stop.

hazards.text: Timer cancel inside its callback would deadlock, avoided non-blocking; sample reuse is avoided by reinit; detachment clears ownership and removal reports busy.
Flexible walks suppress rotation; interrupt-disabled modify stays local; debugger paths need lock check; partial wide failures unwind while teardown scans all processors.
Offsets align to breakpoint size; out-of-line area is one page with slot zero reserved; duplicates and bad slots warn; return overflow discards; unmatched traps signal; nested writes reject.
Bad counters, sealed misuse and allocation failures warn with rollback; symbol file is read-only; reboot runs last and breakpoint faults first; scope uses negative one for none.

invariants.text: Creation validates flags, security and sampling, requires self-led leaders with matching clock and liveness, orders exclusivity checks, and maps five clocks with safety rules.
Inheritance links to original ancestor, skips revoked ancestry and mirrors enable state; teardown deschedules, tombstones and needs single reference for reuse.
Units publish only after full preparation; identifier exchange checks old value; buffer reclaim uses direct, deferred and grace paths; auxiliary completion checks watermark.
Mappings accept file-backed executable areas with inverse translation; delayed entries stay unique; counters need same inode; writes verify-retry with ordered insert.
Out-of-line area is one sealed page with slot zero reserved and move refusal; return instances stack with timer rearm, spare reuse and liveness prune.
Text reservation is interval overlap; key type tracks polarity, linkage and sealing; modules sort and fold on unload; symbol lookup prefers core and formats name with offset and module.

locks.text: Identifier changes use a dedicated mutex; creation holds nested sleepable and read-side sections; migration holds both mutexes; sideband uses per-list spinlock.
Probe consumers use read-write guards, registration exclusive, tree walks shared with retry, fork and delayed work mutexes, leased handles sleepable read guard.
Static-key enable, disable, init, sealing and module notify need processor guard plus global mutex; multiplex rewrites use dedicated mutex; software hash publish uses its own mutex.

state_machines.text: Software timer stops when inactive, otherwise samples with exclusion and advances by clamped period unless overflow ends; clocks accumulate elapsed time, seed stamps and arm on start.
Transactions disable only for add-only work with symmetric commit and cancel; detachment destroys once; breakpoints toggle running; auxiliary exposes storage only while active.
Bulk probe work collects, validates then installs or withdraws; stepping moves to acknowledged or trapped; traps split trampoline handling; handles are single-take with deferred grace free.
Static-key counter has disabled, enabled and transitional states; enable steps through transitional with update; boot sorts entries, rewrites code, groups keys and seals them.

structs.text: Unit state carries identity, scope, device and operations; event state carries placement, grouping and clock; creation defines flags, sentinels and five clocks.
Probe units share software task context with trace add and delete; clock units advertise no non-maskable support; breakpoint unit binds lifecycle handlers with automatic release.
Per-slot histograms track pinned usage with frozen totals; ring carries pages and auxiliary state; out-of-line area pairs waitqueue with bitmap; keys pair inode and offset.
Map nodes link address space with virtual address; per-task probe state holds active probe, stepping, return stack and timer; jump entries use relative offsets; symbol iterators hold positions.
